results.out:
- Measure slow tests: run `pytest --durations=10` or `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`.
- Parallelize tests: run `pytest -n auto` with `pytest-xdist`, or `jest --maxWorkers=4`.
- Mock external calls: replace `requests.get("https://api.example.com")` with `responses.add("GET", "https://api.example.com", json={})`.
- Stub databases: use `pytest.fixture` returning `sqlite3.connect(":memory:")` instead of a live Postgres instance.
- Cache expensive setup: mark fixtures with `scope="session"` in `tests/conftest.py`.
- Avoid full app startup: import `app.routes.users` instead of `app` in `tests/test_users.py`.
- Reduce test data: create 3 records in `tests/fixtures/users.json` instead of 10,000.
- Disable unnecessary integrations: set `EMAIL_BACKEND="django.core.mail.backends.locmem.EmailBackend"` in `settings_test.py`.
- Skip slow tests by default: run `pytest -m "not slow"` and mark slow tests with `@pytest.mark.slow`.
- Use faster assertions: compare `assert response.status_code == 200` instead of `assert response.json() == expected_large_payload`.
- Profile test collection: run `pytest --collect-only -q` to find import-time bottlenecks in `tests/test_imports.py`.
- Split suites by runtime: run `tests/fast/` on every commit and `tests/slow/` nightly in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Reuse browser sessions: configure Playwright with `storageState="tests/auth-state.json"` instead of logging in per test.
- Limit retries: set `pytest --maxfail=1` or `jest --maxWorkers=1` when debugging flaky slow tests.
- Remove sleep calls: replace `time.sleep(2)` with `wait_for(lambda: db.query(User).count() == 3, timeout=5)`.

Release from `main` using semantic versioning and Git tags.

- Create a release PR: `release/v1.2.0` → `main`.
- Bump version: `package.json` → `1.2.0`.
- Update changelog: `CHANGELOG.md` → `## [1.2.0] - 2026-06-15`.
- Run CI: `npm ci && npm test && npm run build`.
- Merge the release PR.
- Tag the release: `git tag -a v1.2.0 -m "v1.2.0"`.
- Publish artifacts: `npm publish --access public`.
- Deploy: `kubectl set image deployment/app app=registry.example.com/app:1.2.0`.
- Verify: `curl https://api.example.com/healthz`.
- Rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/app` or redeploy `v1.1.0`.
- Send `package.json`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, or `Makefile` for exact repo commands.
